CommunityApplications.Profile: VGC Shelf is a self-hosted, open-source video game collection manager for collectors. This application is for tracking physical and digital games, systems, peripherals, toys-to-life collectibles, asset tags, lending/check-outs, wishlists, sell lists, values, reports, metadata lookup, and admin-managed branding. For support, feature requests, and bug reports, use the GitHub repository issues page.
